info.text:
Affirm made nearly half its fiscal 2026 revenue from interest, more than from merchant fees.

FY2026 (year to June 30, 2026): $4.26B revenue. Interest $2.05B (48%), merchant fees $1.15B (27%), other $1.06B (card, loan sales, servicing).
70% of Affirm's FY2026 volume was interest-bearing loans; APRs run 0% to 36%.
Klarna (public since Sept 2025): interest was about 27% of its $3.51B revenue in 2025.
Hypothetical: $1,000 over 12 months at 15% APR = $90.26 a month, $83.10 interest.

Sources: Affirm Form 10-K FY2026, Klarna Form 20-F FY2025.
News and education, not financial advice.
